title: Select between declared train variants with guards in the interlocking

facts.note: Hint only, not a sufficient trigger: task-text terms suggesting mutually selected alternatives or a proposed dispatch mechanism.
Artifacts that declare trains, routes, guards and acceptances.

values: route, guard or train variant added or changed in an interlocking
alternative path added or changed in a journey
facts.note: Needs a plan/source-diff observer that detects added or changed routes, guards, priorities or train variants.

values: the work involves mutually selected alternatives
facts.note: Whether alternatives are truly mutually selected is a semantic judgement.

fires: A journey must handle a cache hit and a cache miss with different trains.
A fallback or recovery path runs when the primary path cannot.
Different workload classes need different linear trains.
A shortcut that skips part of the normal train is wanted.
An existing alternative's steps, errors or observable behavior change.
A new runtime dispatch mechanism is proposed for selecting among alternatives (boundary guidance applies).
doesNotFire: A journey has a single linear train with no mutually selected alternatives.

given: Work involves mutually selected alternatives (workload classes, cache hit/miss, fallbacks, recovery paths or similar); current interlocking route resolution and journey continuations support this.
when: The alternatives are declared or changed.
then: Select among declared linear train variants using the interlocking's deterministic guards and priorities.
prefer: Declare a shortcut as its own route.
Plan tests for matching and nonmatching guards, ambiguity/priority resolution, errors and contract preservation.
Give every branch its own declared guard, train and accepted artifacts (required for each branch, not optional).
avoid: Ambiguous guard matching without new acceptance.
Changed observable behavior without new acceptance.
Inferring unimplemented orchestration behavior from this pattern, or treating it as a new runtime dispatch option.
A branch missing a declared guard, train or accepted artifacts.
why: Current interlocking route resolution and journey continuations support this pattern; unimplemented orchestration behavior cannot be inferred from a pattern.
evidence: Each branch names its declared guard, train and accepted artifacts.
Tests cover matching and nonmatching guards, ambiguity/priority resolution, errors and contract preservation.
Existing plan and source validators apply; this pattern adds no independent enforcement.
verifier_detail: Advisory pattern, severity 3: guidance for agents, not independent enforcement; existing plan and source validators apply.
Ambiguous matching and changed observable behavior are invalid without new acceptance.
Every branch must have declared guard, train and accepted artifacts.
audit: source kind: pattern; status: active; introduced_in 0.1.0
Source term ids: applicability, constraints, evidence, runtime_boundary
Notes: guidance for agents, not independent enforcement or a new runtime dispatch option.
Runtime boundary: supported by current interlocking route resolution and journey continuations.

splitSuggestion.then: Every branch of a guarded alternative has a declared guard, train and accepted artifacts.

additions.text: Activation facts, fires and doesNotFire examples derived from the applicability term, the constraints (changed behavior) and the notes (dispatch boundary).

additions.justification: Schema requires a why; the source has no separate rationale.
